reviews.text: Shane and his crew are very professional! As a single mom I felt very comfortable and confident working with Shane. From start to finish he walked me through and assisted me with the insurance process, picking roof and gutter colors and giving me honest answers to all my questions. I definitely recommend Complete Construction and Roofing and will use them on a remodel for my home in the near future.

I had my roof replaced 4 years ago by Shane from Complete construction his crew did a great job.I recently had some wind damage to my roof from the last bad storm we had in our area, I called Shane and he came right out and replaced the damaged areas at no cost. Excellent service.
I would recommend his company to anyone. Excellent company, excellent service and excellent work.
Thank you Shane.
Shane and his crew just finished a whole house floor replacement. They did an outstanding job. Very meticulous and attention to detail. We are very pleased with the results.

Shane was referred to me by my neighbor after the most recent hail storms. Not only was he knowledgeable and accommodating with my schedule, but most importantly, I felt like he had my back when it came to working with the insurance and explaining the whole process.   Definitely would recommend.
Shane and his crew did an awesome job on my fence. Quality materials and quality work from them, I would highly recommend.
This is a great company to work with. They helped make the insurance claim process go smoothly and repaired my roof and kitchen very nicely.
Kitchen remodel, roof, new floors and paint throughout the house, patio build on and bathroom remodel. Professional quality work everytime.
Shane was awesome to work with. They did everything in a timely manner. I will recommend them to everyone.
Steps, barn doors, soffit, and flooring in barn
Best experience with roofing and general contractor.

Nora, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I'm very sorry to hear about your experience. This is definitely not the standard of service our customers have come to expect from us. Please feel free to contact me, as I would like to know what's caused your disappointment.

data.summary: Reviews show strong signs of inauthenticity. The same 8 reviews appear verbatim on two different Google listings (Local and HQ), which is a major red flag for review duplication or fabrication. The reviews are generic, lack specific details, and show no variation in sentiment. The single negative review has a generic owner response that references a 'Nora', but the review text itself is missing, preventing analysis of complaint patterns. The lack of reviews on other platforms (BBB, Angi, Houzz) for a company claiming multiple remodels and roof replacements is suspicious.
fake_signals: Identical reviews posted on two different Google listings
Reviews lack specific details about projects, timelines, or crew
Writing style is generic and repetitive across multiple reviews
All positive reviews are 5-star with no constructive feedback
Owner response to 1-star review is generic and does not address a specific complaint

mentions: replaced the damaged areas at no cost
positive_evidence: Owner returned to fix wind damage on an old roof at no charge

authentic_signals: Reviews span several years (6 years to 10 months)
Mentions of specific services (roof, fence, floors, kitchen remodel)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available. No other platform ratings to compare.
